# hellodatascience

📦 R package for Supplemental Materials for the Hello Data Science Book

# hellodatascience

**hellodatascience** is a package to supplement the upcoming open-access
*Hello Data Science* book. It contains datasets that are used in the
book. You can find documentation on the [package
website](https://hellodata-science.github.io/hellodatascience/).

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Installation

You can install `hellodatascience` from CRAN.

``` r

install.packages("hellodatascience") 
```

You can install the development version from GitHub. You would also need
to install the devtools package if you do not have it installed already.

``` r

#install.packages("devtools") 
devtools::install_github("hellodata-science/hellodatascience")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`atus_college`](https://hellodata-science.github.io/hellodatascience/reference/atus_college.md)
  : ATUS (American Time Use Survey) College/University Student Data
- [`confederations`](https://hellodata-science.github.io/hellodatascience/reference/confederations.md)
  : FIFA Confederations Data
- [`country_capital`](https://hellodata-science.github.io/hellodatascience/reference/country_capital.md)
  : FIFA World Cup 2026 Country and Capital Data
- [`country_rank`](https://hellodata-science.github.io/hellodatascience/reference/country_rank.md)
  : FIFA World Cup 2026 Country and Ranking Data
- [`mx_us_wc_ranks`](https://hellodata-science.github.io/hellodatascience/reference/mx_us_wc_ranks.md)
  : Mexico's and the United States' World Cup Participation Rankings
  Data
- [`penn_world`](https://hellodata-science.github.io/hellodatascience/reference/penn_world.md)
  : Penn World Data
- [`planets`](https://hellodata-science.github.io/hellodatascience/reference/planets.md)
  : Planets Data
- [`produce_prices`](https://hellodata-science.github.io/hellodatascience/reference/produce_prices.md)
  : Fruit and Vegetable Prices
